info.name: Sigma-Aldrich Product Search Pricing and Availability Safety Data Sheets API

params.name: catalogNumber
params.description: Sigma-Aldrich catalog number (e.g., A1048, M8159, CAS1234-56-7)

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for the SDS (e.g., en-US, de-DE, fr-FR, zh-CN)

params.name: format
params.description: Response format — structured JSON or PDF download URL

items.docs: Returns the GHS-compliant Safety Data Sheet for a specific product. SDSs are available in multiple languages and can be returned as JSON metadata or a PDF document URL for download.
